hypotheses.binder: (hf : MDifferentiableAt I I' f ((extChartAt I α).symm z))
hypotheses.justification: Split on hf. When it holds, use the existing proof. Otherwise, put e = extChartAt I α and x = e.symm z. The composite f ∘ e.symm cannot be MDifferentiableWithinAt on range I at z: composing such differentiability with mdifferentiableAt_extChartAt at x would make (f ∘ e.symm) ∘ e differentiable at x. Here e x = z by hz, e takes values in range I (extChartAt_coe), and e.symm ∘ e is locally the identity on the chart source. Thus MDifferentiableAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq would imply hf, a contradiction. Consequently mfderiv_zero_of_not_mdifferentiableAt and mfderivWithin_zero_of_not_mdifferentiableWithinAt make both derivative maps in the claimed identity zero. Expanding inChartAt_apply and mpullback_apply then proves equality pointwise. This also covers k = 0: both sides evaluate ω on the same empty vector family, rather than necessarily being zero forms. Empty or trivial types introduce no exception.
